card.name: Verb inside "what X considers" phrases
card.fires_on: The verb or auxiliary right after a "what + subject" opening, as in "what we would consider" or "what some would argue is". It is the word that completes the opinion or labeling clause before the noun.

modes.label: Opinion verb
modes.description: Verbs like consider, call, or judge after "what [someone] would".
modes.example: a group of men sat huddled around what we would<< consider>> today to be crude form of the telephone

modes.label: Linking "be" or "is"
modes.description: Be or is after "what ... appeared to" or "what ... judged to", leading into a description.
modes.example: facing what appeared to<< be>> certain death made Michael really think about his
